_comment: The 22 frontier AI and data-science offerings listed on https://seisai.site/courses/ (portfolio prepared July 2026, Spring + Fall 2026 terms). Copied from that page; ids are ours. The page omits foundational SEIS courses (intro Python, database design, algorithms, software engineering, operating systems), which form the technical base every title family below also assumes. Availability belongs to Northeastern's catalog.

clusters.agentic: Agentic AI and AI Systems Engineering
clusters.foundations: AI Computing Foundations and Responsible AI

courses.title: Introduction to Agentic AI
courses.topics: supervised LLM looping, building/tracing/evaluating/supervising agents, tools, reflection, planning, retrieval, memory, multi-agent workflows, safety

courses.title: Intro AI Agent Infrastructure
courses.topics: LLMs from the ground up, embeddings, tokenization, RAG with vector and graph databases, distributed AI infrastructure, Akka actor model

courses.title: Infrastructure & DevOps with LLMs
courses.topics: deploying, operating and integrating LLM-based services into engineering workflows

courses.title: Prompt Engineering & Agentic AI
courses.topics: prompt design, agentic patterns, multi-step task automation, evaluation

courses.title: Self-Improving AI
courses.topics: reinforcement learning, policy gradients (PPO, GRPO), LLM RL training, model adaptation, memory evolution, tool discovery

courses.title: System Design in the Age of AI
courses.topics: software architecture and engineering choices when AI components are part of the system

courses.title: AI Generative Modeling: Theory and Practice
courses.topics: GANs, VAEs, diffusion, transformers, LLMs, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, Bayesian networks, PyTorch/TensorFlow

courses.title: Advanced Techniques with LLMs
courses.topics: state-of-the-art LLM methods, prompt strategies, retrieval and tool use, applied generative AI workflows

courses.title: Natural Language Engineering Methods/Tools
courses.topics: NLP through transformers, GenAI/LLMs, LoRA fine-tuning, RAG, LLM agents, reasoning, RLHF

courses.title: Semantic Intelligence in LLM
courses.topics: meaning representation and reasoning in LLMs, applied NLP for search and knowledge work

courses.title: Gen AI with LLMs in Data Engineering
courses.topics: LLMs applied to data engineering workflows and pipelines

courses.title: Knowledge Graphs with GenAI/Databases
courses.topics: structured knowledge representation combined with generative AI, graph databases

courses.title: Deep Learning / Generative Modeling for Healthcare
courses.topics: deep learning and generative modeling for clinical and biomedical problems

courses.title: Machine Learning for Medical Devices
courses.topics: ML in safety-sensitive regulated medical-device contexts, validation

courses.title: Branding and AI
courses.topics: generative AI for communication, brand strategy and creative workflows

courses.title: User Experience in the Era of Gen AI
courses.topics: how AI changes product interaction, user expectations and workflow design

courses.title: Building AI Applications
courses.topics: turning AI capabilities into usable software: prototyping, deployment, user-facing AI

courses.title: High-Performance Parallel Machine Learning and AI
courses.topics: parallel ML/DL on heterogeneous clusters and accelerators

courses.title: High Performance Computing for AI
courses.topics: compute infrastructure for AI: parallel execution, hardware acceleration, scalable training and inference

courses.title: Computational Skepticism
courses.topics: critical evaluation of AI outputs, uncertainty, verification, limitations, responsible use

courses.title: Neural Modeling Methods and Tools
courses.topics: graph-theoretic neural models, explainability, trust in machine-generated models

courses.title: Data Engineering for AI
courses.topics: data pipelines, preparation and infrastructure for reliable AI systems
